t: About Sonoco | Sonoco Products Company
s: Go back 126 years and envision a small team of 12 working in a rented warehouse in the small town of Hartsville, South Carolina on the Southern Novelty Company’s first product: a cone-shaped paper yarn carrier used for winding and transporting yarn. Since textile cones at the time were typically wooden, these paper cones were indeed a novelty. This innovative product positioned what is now Sonoco as the leading producer of cones in the United States.
